entities.name: Francis Marion Walker
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Marion Walker was a Confederate States Army officer during the American Civil War. He was killed while commanding a brigade at the Battle of Atlanta of July 22, 1864, one day before his commission as a brigadier general in the Confederate Army was delivered.
